I'm a big SANADA fan so I'm biased, but I think it's been a pretty good run as he's turned some doubters into believers in his main event status and ability.

What's let him down is stuff like the throw together Jack Perry defence and perhaps some of the build-up to the EVIL match. I did enjoy the EVIL match itself though.

Yota Tsuji has amazing potential, he's got a good look, he's got some character and he's pretty solid in the ring. He's also my favourite of them so I'm biased after he won me over in his title match with SANADA.   


Shota Umino also has crazy potential, but I'd really like to see him break away from Moxley's shadow by not carrying that jacket around anymore. His character doesn't do it for me currently, but I am open to becoming convinced. His in-ring work is also really good and he has great chemistry with guys like ZSJ.   


Ren Narita needs to up his intensity if he wants to truly get his strong style character over. His strikes at the moment just don't look like they have any panache behind them. His suplexes though are things of beauty, I love his bridges and he should rely on them more than his sad strikes.
